description:
FILED s518e (Opus 5.5, 2026-10-17) by Fable's ruling (s518, 11:0x): Type-Tiny does NOT join the board in s518e -- a board leg must stay ~20-30 min (it runs at every merge and in every agent's final legs), and Type-Tiny's 375 t-files at ~45 s each would add ~70 min at --jobs 4.  The one-time census by cause (s518e member 2) is recorded below; nothing is blessed for a dist that does not join.

THE MEASUREMENT THAT DECIDES THE TARGET (one typical file, t/21-types/Int.t, s518e tree, box load 3-9):
  transpile the t-file (pl2cl --no-cache)                      2.8 s
  run, module cache OFF (the board runner's *pcl-skip-cache*)  46.0 s
  run, module cache COLD                                       50.1 s
  run, module cache WARM                                       43.3 s
  perl, whole file                                              0.07 s
and the discriminator programs (runpcl, warm cache):
  `print "empty"`                                               0.2 s
  `use Types::Standard qw(Int); print "loaded"`                 45.8 s (49.5 cold)
  the same + 30 `Int->where(sub {...})->check` types            43.3 s
So (a) transpiling Type::Tiny's modules is NOT the cost (warm vs cold ~4 s; the module cache works), (c) the tests are NOT the cost (30 extra types add nothing measurable): it is (b) LOADING Types::Standard, which runs 113 string evals carrying 27,377 characters of generated Perl (counted under perl -d, keys `_<(eval N)` after `use Types::Standard qw(Int)`) -- ~0.38 s per eval string through PCL's eval path (transpile + SBCL compile), uncached across runs (a second warm run is not faster).

TARGET: the eval path's per-string cost (STATUS.md's Moo-class cost; the planned cheaper compile for eval strings -- e.g. the interpreter / a fasl cache keyed by eval text + captures).  Type-Tiny joins when a board leg including it stays under ~30 min: at ~5 s per file (the empty-program floor plus a cheap load) 375 files cost ~8 min at --jobs 4.

HOW TO RUN IT (tooling shipped s518e): `tools/cpan-scoreboard.pl --jobs 4 --timeout 120 "--dist-inc=$HOME/.cpan/build/Exporter-Tiny-1.006003/lib,$HOME/.cpan/build/Type-Tiny-2.010001/inc" ~/.cpan/build/Type-Tiny-2.010001` (the dist's own make test adds inc/; Exporter-Tiny is fetched, never installed); `--only=REGEX` runs a chunk; t-files are found recursively.  The dists-file line when it joins: `Type-Tiny-2.010001<TAB>--inc=Exporter-Tiny-1.006003/lib,Type-Tiny-2.010001/inc<TAB>sNNN<TAB>type constraints: closures, overload via stash entries, string-eval code generation`.
subject: Type-Tiny joins the CPAN board when a board leg including it stays under ~30 min -- today each of its 375 t-files costs ~45 s, and the cost is LOADING Types::Standard: 113 string evals (27 KB of generated Perl) at ~0.38 s each through PCL's eval path (the module cache and the tests themselves are not the cost)
